title: The Mysterious Traveler
paragraphs: A mystery, suspense, and speculative-fiction anthology introduced by an enigmatic traveler who guides listeners into tales of crime, fate, the supernatural, and strange possibilities.
Mutual anthology of strange, terrifying, criminal, supernatural and speculative stories created by Robert A. Arthur and David Kogan.
The run breaks into several distinct periods: Mutual anthology run (December 5, 1943 to September 16, 1952) on [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include [[person|maurice-tarplin|Maurice Tarplin]] (performer), David Kogan (writer, director, and producer), Robert A. Arthur (writer, director, and producer), Carl Caruso (announcer), Paul Taubman (organist), Al Fanelli (organist), and Jock MacGregor (director).
Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]], [[org|org.50630574777d6937|Don Lee Network]], and [[org|org.5503c31f28e9e966|KXOA]].

The stories often return to murder, homicide and criminal violence, ghosts, curses and supernatural return, speculative science, inventions and experiments, dreams, obsession, fear and psychological instability, war, Hitler and wartime catastrophe, and space, rockets and other worlds.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Wartime fear and enemy imagery, Postwar science and technological anxiety, Low-cost sustaining network anthology, and Mysterious Traveler cross-media franchise.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|words-at-war|Words at War]], [[show|columbia-workshop|Columbia Workshop]], [[show|theater-five|Theater Five]], [[show|x-minus-one|X Minus One]], and [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]].
